answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the forge check. Bindings are kept in saffron, verified in ridge, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. The attacker spends 220 dollars and 2 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
